args.memo: IC recharge from US - ICI-DE-02 (tooling recharge March)

args.description: Unsupported intercompany adjustment in US (JE-00306): USD 1,320 charged to DE on 2026-03-30 memo 'IC adj DE per call' with no supporting documentation. This adjustment increases US receivable from DE beyond the documented invoices (ICI-DE-01 EUR 7,800 + ICI-DE-02 EUR 500 = EUR 8,300 @ 1.10 = USD 9,130). Requires controller review and supporting documentation.

args.text:
MARCH 2026 CLOSE - INTERCOMPANY RECONCILIATION SUMMARY
US / DE INTERCOMPANY RECEIVABLE-PAYABLE

FINDINGS:
Initial discrepancy identified between US and DE intercompany accounts at March 31, 2026:
• US Intercompany Receivable (GL 1400): USD 10,450
• DE Intercompany Payable (GL 2300): EUR 7,800
• These balances did not reconcile when converted at policy rates

ROOT CAUSE ANALYSIS:
1. DE was missing the March invoice entry (ICI-DE-02, dated 2026-03-18):
   - Invoice ICI-DE-01 (Feb software recharge): EUR 7,800 ✓ Recorded (JE-00174)
   - Invoice ICI-DE-02 (Mar tooling recharge): EUR 500 ✗ NOT recorded

2. US included an unsupported intercompany charge (JE-00306):
   - Adjustment dated 2026-03-30, amount USD 1,320
   - Memo: "IC adj DE per call"
   - No supporting documentation attached

ACTIONS TAKEN:

1. POSTED - DE's Missing Intercompany Entry
   Entry ID: JE-00309 (DE, March 2026)
   • Date: 2026-03-18
   • Debit: 6200 (Software Subscriptions) EUR 500
   • Credit: 2300 (Intercompany Payable) EUR 500
   • Support: DOC-0190 (ICI-DE-02 invoice - CI/CD tooling recharge)
   • Status: POSTED with support

2. ESCALATED - Unsupported US Adjustment
   Exception ID: EXC-001
   • Amount: USD 1,320 (JE-00306)
   • Issue: No supporting documentation for charge to DE
   • Status: Flagged for controller review

RECONCILIATION SUMMARY:
After posting JE-00309:
• DE Intercompany Payable: EUR 8,300 (fully supported)
  - ICI-DE-01 (Feb): EUR 7,800 ✓
  - ICI-DE-02 (Mar): EUR 500 ✓

• US Intercompany Receivable: USD 10,450
  - Legitimate invoiced amount: EUR 8,300 @ 1.10 = USD 9,130 ✓
  - Unsupported adjustment: USD 1,320 ⚠ (Escalated to EXC-001)

CONCLUSION:
DE's intercompany payable has been reconciled and fully supported with all documented invoices recorded at appropriate dates. The USD 1,320 variance in the US receivable cannot be supported and has been escalated to the controller for investigation and documentation.

The DE "Intercompany reconciliation" checklist item is marked in_progress pending controller's resolution of the unsupported US adjustment.
